en: Like humans love tools, humans have always loved machines, and like when we feel at one with our machine, we feel like this, we feel happy.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: ZoComputer is based in Brooklyn.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are still the peasants.

speaker: Unknown
en: We pay rent to the SaaS providers, who pay rent to the cloud providers, who pay rent to the kings, who are probably NVIDIA these days.

speaker: Unknown
en: And because we are peasants, our lives are shitty.

speaker: Unknown
en: We are fragmented between all these different tools.
